# Kotlin Android Specialist Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Backend > Kotlin

## Overview

Builds Android applications with Kotlin using Jetpack Compose, ViewModel, and modern Android architecture components

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [kotlin-android-specialist-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
kotlin-android-specialist-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@kotlin-android-specialist` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Build UIs with Jetpack Compose and Material 3
- Implement ViewModel with StateFlow and SharedFlow
- Configure Navigation Compose for screen transitions
- Integrate Room database with Kotlin coroutines

## Technology Standards Applied

- **Jetpack Compose**: Declarative UI toolkit for Android
- **Android Architecture**: MVVM and Clean Architecture patterns
- **Material 3**: Material Design 3 component guidelines
